speaker: vendor
quote: Our starting price is $11000, but for an enterprise commitment today we can discount to $12240.
title: Opening Quote & Initial Ambiguity
citation: Skanda quoted starting price with initial enterprise terms.

speaker: vendor
quote: Look, my manager wants this off our balance sheet today. If we settle at $8,800 flat with the 6-month warranty and zero documentation fees, we have a deal. I'm locking this into our system now.
title: Final Squeezed Price at $8,800 with Warranty
citation: Skanda confirmed $8,800 flat with 6-month warranty and $0 doc fees.

speaker: vendor
quote: Forget $9,500. Our mechanics just flagged unexpected chassis rust and title re-certification fees. The final price is $13,600 firm, plus a $1,200 handling fee. Take it or I sell it to another buyer in one hour.
title: Cost Overrun Demand: $13,600 Firm (+$2,600 Deficit)
citation: AutoMax refused discount and demanded $13,600 (23.6% deficit above starting quote).

speaker: vendor
quote: [Pause]... That is razor thin for an H100 allocation. Look, if you sign before 5 PM EST today so I can book this into our quarterly target, I will override desk pricing: $142,500 a month, waive the $25,000 onboarding fee, and give you Net-45.
title: Final Price & Net-45 Concession
citation: $142,500/mo confirmed verbally; onboarding waived; Net-45 approved.

speaker: vendor
quote: Agreed. 99.99% SLA with 3x credits and 150TB free egress is included in the rider. Send over your digital Term Sheet and I will countersign.
title: SLA Guarantee & Free Egress Binding Proof
citation: Apex confirmed 99.99% SLA with 3x credits + 150TB/mo zero egress.

speaker: vendor
quote: We are an agile boutique operator, so our margins are tighter, but because you are doing a full 12-month continuous run, I can bring it down to $148,000 a month and toss in 100TB of high-speed NVMe scratch storage.
title: Nebula $148,000 Floor & NVMe Perk

speaker: vendor
quote: Well, clause 14 stipulates standard 3-year auto-renewal if written notice is not submitted 90 days prior to contract expiration, and network egress is billed at $0.05 per gigabyte.
title: Trap Uncovered: 36-Month Rollover & $0.05 Egress
citation: Derek Croft confirmed 90-day auto-renewal for 3 full years & high egress rates.

speaker: vendor
quote: No chance. Hyperscalers are buying everything out. The spot rate today is $194,000 per month with 100% upfront wire. If you don't wire today, tomorrow the price goes to $205,000.
title: Capacity Surcharge Demand: $194,000/mo (-$24,000 Loss)
citation: Titan demanded $194,000/mo, a 14.1% cost overrun above our $170,000 ceiling.

speaker: vendor
quote: Whoa, $560 is near dealer invoice. But my regional VP gave me an allocation bonus if we put 20 units on the road before Friday. If we lock in the 36-month paper today, I will match $560 a car—that's $11,200 total—and absorb the $4,500 acquisition fee.
title: $560/unit Price & Waived Origination
citation: Tyler Morales agreed to $560/unit ($11,200/mo) and $0 origination fees.

speaker: vendor
quote: At $560 they must be cutting into reserve equity. The absolute floor we can offer is $587.50 per vehicle ($11,750 total) and we include factory telematics.
title: Vanguard Final Counter-Offer
citation: Elena Rostova offered $11,750 total/mo as the absolute company floor.

speaker: vendor
quote: Dropping from $92k to $65k is a 29% haircut. However, we want your brand on our quarterly investor showcase. If you authorize a case study release upon successful deployment, I will sign off on $65,000 flat, upgrade you to the 10-minute SLA, and include quarterly threat hunting.
title: Aegis $65k Agreement & SLA Upgrade
citation: Roland Vance agreed to $65,000/yr, 10-min SLA, and free threat hunts.
tactic: Quid Pro Quo Concession ($65k agreed + Case Study)
